lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 6 distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section with a slightly wider gap between the two most anterior lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the fourth line from the posterior, which splits into a Y-shape towards the dorsal ridge. Lines 5 and 6 converge at the ventral margin.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first posterior line is truncated, terminating in the mid-flank region. The most anterior line (6th) terminates before reaching the dorsal crest.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Only a single high-contrast spot is visible on the posterior haunch; remainder of the region is occluded by foreground terrain.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Spiral lyrate curvature. Horns diverge laterally from the frontal bone before curving medially and anteriorly toward the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the apical tips is approximately 2.1 times the width of the horn base.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the eyes and a distinct white band on the lower forelimbs above the carpal joint.
